text: I cannot understand this visit—what does she mean? And she suspects that past time of ours.” “I am in your hands. If you think she had better not see me here I’ll go into the next room.” “Well, yes—go.” Wildeve at once withdrew; but before he had been half a minute in the adjoining apartment Eustacia came after him. “No,” she said, “we won’t have any of this. If she comes in she must see you—and think if she likes there’s something wrong!
